# Responsive Regression Check

Run focused responsive checks for layout safety.

## Checks

- Card overlap/overflow
- Off-screen controls
- Tap target usability
- Orientation transitions

## Output

```text
Responsive Status: pass | fail
Findings:
- <finding>
Required Fixes:
- <fix>
```
